explanation: It is non-zero only at D1, and only when the previous trial chose a1 and reached S1 (common); then it is about 9-10, especially right after a trial that reached S2, and it drifts down to about 7-8 over a run of such trials (2-5 in long steady a1 runs), whether or not that trial was rewarded. It is 0 at every GO and D2, and also at D1 after any trial that reached S2; after a2 reached S1 (rare) it is usually 0, sometimes 4-7.
